operator: Lagos Rail Mass Transit — Blue Line (LAMATA / Eko Rail concession)
notes: Lagos Blue Line, Phase 1 (operational 5 stations, ~13 km, opened 2023-09-04). Stops and order verified from LAMATA blue-line-train-schedule page + en.wikipedia Blue Line (Lagos Transit): Marina - National Theatre - Orile Iganmu - Suru Alaba - Mile 2 (line will extend west to Okokomaiko; those planned stations are NOT included as they are not yet in service). Station coordinates are exact, pulled from OpenStreetMap railway=station nodes along the corridor via Overpass API (operator LAMATA subway relations Mile2<->Marina). Service window is faithful to LAMATA's published schedule: Marina->Mile 2 departures 05:30-21:50; Mile 2->Marina departures 05:40-21:52. Service days Mon-Sat full (one source reports limited Sunday service; modeled Mon-Sat only, which matches the LAMATA schedule page 'Monday to Saturday Service'). HEADWAY MODELING: the LAMATA page states '51 trains daily' per direction and '8-12 min peak', while Wikipedia (Feb 2026) observed ~23 min average with ~36 trips/direction. These conflict; real service is peak-dense / off-peak-sparse, not a fixed clockface. I modeled an EVEN ~20-minute headway across the full window (50 outbound + 49 inbound = 99 trips), which reproduces the stated ~51 trips/direction and a realistic daily average, but individual clock times are synthesized (LAMATA's per-train timetable rows load via JS and were not machine-readable). Inter-station run times synthesized to hit the documented ~14-15 min end-to-end journey with ~60-90s dwell at intermediate stations. route_type=1 (metro/subway): grade-separated electrified EMU line, mapped as route=subway in OSM. Because exact per-train departure times could not be extracted, confidence is moderate (0.55): geography/stops/service span are solid; individual trip times are a plausible even-headway synthesis, not the operator's exact timetable.
